newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian stocks move higher in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Estonian stocks move higher in moderate trade.

text.p: Union bank was the most active stock in moderate trade on Estonia's bourse with most stocks firming on Wednesday, dealers said.
Total volume on the official list reached 40.7 million kroons and the Tallinn stock exchange index edged 0.32 percent higher to 210.33.
"On the whole there was not much activity in the afternoon, with a few block trades," one dealer said.
Union Bank was the most traded during the morning with Hansapank picking up in the afternoon.
Union Bank registered a gain of 0.15 kroons to close on 44.95 kroons with a turnover of 13.4 million kroons.
"Union Bank's volume was good and it was supported by buying from Helsinki," one trader said.
"Helsinki's interest started on Tuesday afternoon and continued through to today," he added.
Hansapank turned over 10.8 million kroons to end 0.45 higher on 210.45 kroons.
In other stocks Hoiupank (Savings Bank) firmed to 102.00 kroons, a rise of 0.20 kroons on 7.6 million kroons of shares traded.
Tallinna Pank rebounded over the 60.00 kroon hurdle to close on 60.05 kroons, up 0.30 on trade of 5.2 million kroons.
The free market was less active with a volume of 8.9 million kroons of shares changing hands.
Diversified industrialist, Norma, was the most active stock with trade valued at 6.5 million kroons. Norma eased to 61.45, 0.35 kroons lower.
Norma and Rakvere are always liquid stocks with a high trade and this sets them aside from the other stocks on the free market," one dealer said.
